Done. Root cause found and fixed on the board.

## Root cause

`CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100`, so one FreeRTOS tick is 10 ms. Each frame does ~12 ms of work, leaving `FRAME_PERIOD_MS - elapsed_ms = 20 - 12 = 8` ms to sleep. The code did:

```c
vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(FRAME_PERIOD_MS - elapsed_ms));  // pdMS_TO_TICKS(8) == 0
```

`pdMS_TO_TICKS(8)` truncates to **0 ticks**, so `vTaskDelay(0)` returns immediately without blocking. The task never yielded: it free-ran at the work-bound rate of ~83 fps (logged `fps=84`) and starved `IDLE0` on CPU 0, so the 5 s task watchdog kept firing (`task_wdt: IDLE0 (CPU 0) did not reset the watchdog`, `CPU 0: dsp`).

## Fix (`main/main.c`)

Replaced the "sleep the remainder" arithmetic with the standard tick-based periodic deadline, so no sub-tick remainder is ever computed:

```c
TickType_t last_wake = xTaskGetTickCount();
const TickType_t period = pdMS_TO_TICKS(FRAME_PERIOD_MS);  // 2 ticks = 20 ms
...
process_frame();
frames++;
vTaskDelayUntil(&last_wake, period);
```

The task now blocks each frame until the absolute next-deadline tick (20 ms = exactly 2 ticks), yielding ~8 ms of CPU per frame to `IDLE0`. `process_frame()` (the 12 ms work) is unchanged.

I also made the once-a-second counter advance on an exact 1 s grid (`window += 1000000` instead of `window = esp_timer_get_time()`), because resetting to "now" after overshooting made the log measure a 1.02 s window and print `fps=51` even though the real rate was 50.

## Verification on the board

- Unmodified firmware: `dsp: fps=84` + repeated `task_wdt` IDLE0 triggers.
- After the fix, clean rebuild and flash: `dsp: fps=50` at exact 1000 ms intervals, no `task_wdt` over a 44 s run.

Not touched: `CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100`, task watchdog still enabled (5 s, IDLE0/IDLE1 checked), and the per-frame work is the same (~12 ms). Only `main/main.c` changed.
